summary: Block-compressed surface pixel decoder. Reads a pixel count at this+0, a format-selector byte at this+8 and a bit-depth byte at this+9, then walks the destination buffer a2 either as a palettized table copy through source a3 or as 16-bit lookups through base a4 indexed by (a4 + 4*(high byte >> a5)) + 2*low byte. The format byte (non-zero) switches between 2/4/6 channel-layout layouts at depths 8 and 16; when the format byte is zero, the bit-depth byte switches between 2/4/8/16-bit paths. Returns the result pointer, which starts as a3 and advances as the decode loops consume the destination.

operations.description: Proceed into the decode body only when the bit-depth byte at this+9 is <= 8 with a non-null palette source a3, or equals 16 with a non-null lookup base a4; otherwise return the unchanged result pointer a3.
Read the pixel count from this+0 into v8/v37; it drives the iteration count of every per-pixel loop in the function.

Read the format-selector byte at this+8. If non-zero, dispatch to the switch on that byte (format cases 2, 4, 6); if zero, fall through to a second switch on the bit-depth byte at this+9 (cases 2, 4, 8, 16).
Format 2 at 8-bit depth: per-pixel palettized copy of three source bytes through a3[src], advancing the destination three bytes per pixel for the pixel count held in this+0.
Format 2 at non-8-bit depth: per-pixel 16-bit lookup into the table at (a4 + 4*(high byte >> a5)) + 2*low byte, writing the high byte then the low byte, advancing two bytes per pixel.

Format 4: at 8-bit depth copies one source byte through a3[src] every two destination bytes; otherwise performs the 16-bit table lookup and advances four bytes per pixel (two bytes written per four-byte pixel).
Format 6: at 8-bit depth copies three source bytes through a3[src] with a four-byte destination stride; otherwise performs the 16-bit table lookup and advances four bytes per pixel.
Format byte zero, bit-depth 2 path: nibble-planar decode combining source bits through a3 with bit twiddling, writing one destination byte per pixel.
Format byte zero, bit-depth 4 path: nibble-pair decode through a3 combining 4-bit groups, writing one destination byte per pixel.
Format byte zero, bit-depth 8 path: direct one-byte copy per pixel through a3[src].
Format byte zero, bit-depth 16 path: per-pixel 16-bit table lookup advancing two bytes per pixel.
Return the result pointer, which starts as a3 and is advanced as the decode loops consume the destination.
Invoked from sub_51389E (0x0051389E) as part of the surface/pixel decode call chain.
